events.title: The Peeing Update
events.summary: Peeing can be enabled in experimental mode, and used by holding “P” on your keyboard, or you can rebind it to whatever you want. Peeing sends you flying like the jet pack in goat simulator, can be used to reach places you normally could not.Fixed build-able cars to properly kill you when they explode which avoids a game breaking glitch.Added Peeing to experimental mode just hit “P’’, make sure to enable it.Fixed shopping cart from messing up- your hp.Fixed accept button on experimental mode wind

events.title: Welcome to Crackheads!
events.summary: So happy to have so many of you interested in the project, this game is fully guided by you the community and what you think would be fun. Know that I will always listen to you and do the best I can to deliver an amazing and super fun game.
